description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Yakima Chief Hops is hiring a Junior Software Engineer to support development, testing, and maintenance of its enterprise integration and e-commerce systems. The role primarily supports the .NET integration layer and Next.js commerce site, with opportunities to grow into enterprise system integrations.
Junior Software Engineer implementing integration-layer and commerce-site features, maintaining tests, and resolving software defects under senior guidance

Responsibilities:
• Implement well-defined features, bug fixes, and enhancements across the integration layer and/or the commerce site, under the guidance of senior engineers
• Write and maintain unit and integration tests for the code you contribute
• Participate in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback
• Create and update technical documentation for the features and integrations you work on
• Help troubleshoot and resolve reported bugs and production issues, escalating appropriately
• Learn the connections between our ERP, the integration layers, and the commerce site
• Collaborate with other developers, product owners, and stakeholders across the team
• Continually build working knowledge of relevant tools, languages, and systems
• Maintain sanitary and safe work environment and follow safety requirements
• May actively participate on company’s Safety Committee
• Ensure that company safety policies as well as federal, state and local safety and environmental regulations are observed
• Must have a complete understanding of company’s policies, Employee Handbook, SOPs, QPs, EPs, HACCP and cGMP that pertain to their department to ensure quality, safety, efficiency and sustainability
• Must adhere to all company policies
• Examine documents, materials, and products and monitor work processes to assess completeness, accuracy and conformance to standards and specifications
• Follow all SOPs in a given area
• Perform all other duties as assigned by Manager and/or designee

Requirements:
• Demonstrate a strong sense of customer service, work ethic, and positivity, and contribute to the company mission and vision in a collaborative, team-oriented environment
• Professional written, verbal, and visual communication skills
• Foundational experience in at least one of the following, with genuine interest in learning the other: Python, C#/.NET, or Next.js/TypeScript
• Working knowledge of relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar) and basic SQL query writing
• Familiarity with a modern version control system (Git) and collaborative development workflows
• Basic understanding of Agile principles and terminology (e.g., sprints, backlog, user stories, stand-ups)
• Basic understanding of how web applications communicate with APIs, web services, or integrations (REST, GraphQL, etc.)
• Coursework, internship, or project experience with object-oriented programming, relational databases, and web fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
• Bachelor's degree from a four-year college or university in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience (internships, bootcamp, self-directed projects)

Preferred:
• Exposure to Microsoft Azure or another cloud platform
• Exposure to React or Next.js
• Familiarity with deployment pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar) through Coursework or personal projects
• Basic understanding of application security fundamentals (secure coding practices, authentication, dependency management)
• Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot)
• Familiarity with package managers such as Composer, NuGet, or npm
• Experience with project management or issue-tracking tools such as Jira
